items.description: A self-improving RLM agent for coding workflows and long-running autonomous tasks.
items.readme:
Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Agent

Documentation • Verifiers • PRIME-RL • pi-mono

Prime Agent is an open-source coding and research agent for general and long-running work. ## Features

We aim to build a complete, usable browser for the modern web.

Ladybird uses a multi-process architecture with a main UI process, several WebContent renderer processes,

Image decoding and network connections are done out of process to be more robust against malicious content.

- LibHTTP: HTTP/1.1 client
- LibGfx: 2D Graphics Library, Image Decoding and Rendering
- LibUnicode: Unicode and locale support
- LibMedia: Audio and video playback

# celld

Self-hosted, distributed **Durable Objects**.

celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable
Objects on your own machines. Each object is its own SQLite database,
addressed by name and replicated to an
S3-compatible bucket you own; nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with
no control plane or consensus. Because every object is its own small database,
applications shard by construction — the contention and blast-radius failures
of one shared database are designed out, not managed. Idle cells hibernate to
nearly nothing. Learn more at [celld.dev](https://celld.dev) or read the
[documentation](https://celld.dev/docs).

## How it works

Every `celld` node embeds V8 and executes Wrangler bundles. The fleet shares an
S3-compatible bucket containing deployments, cell state, and small ownership
records. Object-storage compare-and-swap ensures that exactly one node owns a
cell at a time, without a membership protocol, failure detector, or consensus
service.

celld continuously replicates each cell's SQLite database to the bucket.
When a cell moves or wakes up, its new owner restores that database and resumes
execution. The bucket is the durable source of truth; nodes are replaceable.

## Install

The installer downloads the `celld` binary (provenance is verifiable with
`gh attestation verify`):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://celld.dev/install.sh | sh
```

Put `~/.local/bin` on your `PATH` if the installer asks you to.

Worker projects deployed with `celld deploy` need
[esbuild](https://esbuild.github.io) on `PATH`; asset-only projects do not.

The installer keeps verified releases under `~/.local/lib/celld/releases` and
atomically switches one `current` pointer. To remove celld, use the guarded
uninstaller:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://celld.dev/uninstall.sh | sh
```

## Container

The release image contains the `celld` binary and is published for Linux
x86-64 and ARM64:

```sh
docker run --rm ghcr.io/denoland/celld --version
```

T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". [中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](./README.ja.md) | [Русский](./README.ru.md)

Local web UI for the [pi coding agent](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono). Pi Web reads your local pi session files and gives you a browser workspace for session browsing, real-time chat, model configuration, skill management, and project file preview.

![Pi Web shows the same pi session with structured Markdown, tool calls, and project navigation beside the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agegr/pi-web/main/docs/screenshot2.png)

The same pi session in CLI and Pi Web: structured tool calls, readable Markdown, session browsing, and cleaner results.

## Quick Start

Pi Web requires Node.js 22.19.0 or newer. Check your version with `node --version`.

**Run without installing:**

```bash
npx @agegr/pi-web@latest
```

**Or install globally:**

```bash
npm install -g @agegr/pi-web
pi-web
```

Then open [http://127.0.0.1:30141](http://127.0.0.1:30141). The CLI will try to open the browser automatically after the server is ready. Pi Web listens on `127.0.0.1` by default.

**Options:**

```bash
pi-web --port 8080              # custom port
pi-web --hostname 0.0.0.0       # expose on a trusted network
pi-web -p 8080 -H 0.0.0.0       # combine options
pi-web --no-open                # do not open the browser automatically

PORT=8080 pi-web                # environment variable is also supported
PI_WEB_HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 pi-web  # explicit network exposure
PI_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS=pi-web.internal pi-web  # allow an exact proxy/custom hostname
PI_WEB_PASSWORD='a-long-random-password' pi-web  # require Basic Auth (username: pi)
PI_WEB_NO_OPEN=1 pi-web         # useful when running as a background service
```

Set `PI_WEB_PASSWORD` to protect the web interface and every API endpoint with HTTP Basic Auth. The username is always `pi`. Leaving the variable unset or empty disables authentication.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: Meta 提出算力过剩观点后 AI 股市应声下跌，引发行业焦虑。文章反思 AI 应用三年未爆发的原因：基础设施投入巨大但 killer app 缺失，用户对 ChatGPT 等工具的新鲜感消退，而企业级落地面临成本和安全挑战。作者认为 AI 不会重蹈互联网泡沫，但需要找到像抖音微信那样的超级场景才能引爆下一波增长。
items.summary_en: When Meta suggested there was too much computing capacity, AI stocks tumbled, revealing deep anxiety in the industry. This article reflects on why AI applications haven't exploded after three years: massive infrastructure spending without a killer app, declining novelty of chatbots like ChatGPT, and enterprise deployment hurdles around cost and security. The author argues it's not a repeat of the 2000 dot-com bubble, but AI needs its own TikTok or WeChat moment to trigger the next growth wave. It's a sobering reality check for the industry.

The projects showcase cutting-edge developments in AI agents, decentralized skill trading platforms, AI-powered video generation, smart code completion and review tools, and high-performance parallel scheduling frameworks. items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.summary_zh: 这篇文章完整记录了一位开发者利用AI辅助技术从零构建并上线微信小游戏的全过程。作者毫无保留地公开了技术栈、提示词（prompt）设计、遇到的各类踩坑问题以及详细的成本明细，甚至附有彩蛋。对于想尝试用AI加速小游戏开发但又缺乏经验的团队或个人来说，这篇实战复盘提供了真实可参考的路线图和避坑指南，展现了AI在降低开发门槛方面的巨大潜力。
items.summary_en: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of building and launching a WeChat mini game entirely with AI assistance. The author shares everything from the technology stack and prompt engineering techniques to a detailed breakdown of costs and a list of common pitfalls encountered during the process, ending with a hidden bonus. For indie developers or small teams curious about leveraging AI to speed up game development, this real-world case study serves as an invaluable reference. It demonstrates how AI tools can dramatically lower the barrier to entry for game creation, making it accessible even to those without a deep coding background.

items.summary_zh: 作者在面试中发现，多数候选人谈业务时只复述职责，例如负责订单模块、做支付对接、写库存扣减，认为这就是业务理解。文章指出这属于工作经历而非业务理解，并探讨二者区别，适合正在准备面试或想从“做功能”转向“懂业务”的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: Drawing on interviews, the author argues that most candidates confuse business understanding with a list of past features—they mention order modules, payment integrations, or stock-deduction logic, but that's work history, not business insight. The post explores the gap between the two and is useful for developers preparing for interviews or trying to grow beyond feature delivery.

items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了如何设计一个优秀的AI技能系统，重点介绍了“具身交互智能”这一前沿概念，即让AI拥有身体并能感知世界、理解环境、通过语音表情动作与人自然互动。这一设计理念将推动AI从纯语言模型向多模态、有实体的智能体进化，解决AI在物理世界中行动和感知的难题，对开发者设计下一代人机交互产品具有重要启发意义。
items.summary_en: This article explores how to design an excellent AI skills system, focusing on the cutting-edge concept of 'embodied interactive intelligence.' It argues that the next phase of AI goes beyond reasoning—AI should have a body, perceive the world, understand environments, and interact through voice, expressions, and gestures. This approach solves the problem of AI operating in physical spaces, enabling more natural human-machine collaboration. Developers building the next generation of smart assistants, robots, or metaverse avatars will find these design principles transformative.

It directly addresses whether an ordinary person with zero experience can build a commercial, monetizable mini game with AI. Useful for indie developers exploring AI-driven game production.

items.title: 全网都在吹的 Kimi K3，到底怎么样？
items.description: 国产最贵、速度还慢，凭什么还是国产之光？Kimi K3 前端能力全球第一梯队，长任务处理稳，还是开源模型，这次是真敢跟顶尖闭源模型掰手腕了。
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3 虽然价格昂贵、速度偏慢，却凭借其全球第一梯队的前端（视觉）能力和稳定的长任务处理表现，被称为国产之光。它还是开源模型，敢于与顶尖闭源模型竞争，尤其在代码和视觉相关的任务上展现强大实力。对于追求开源和高质量视觉理解的开发者来说，Kimi K3 是一个值得关注的选项。
items.summary_en: Kimi K3, despite being expensive and relatively slow, has earned the reputation as a light of domestic AI thanks to its top-tier front-end visual capabilities and stable long-task processing. It is open-source and dares to compete with leading closed-source models. Particularly strong in code-related and visual understanding tasks, Kimi K3 offers a compelling option for developers who value transparency and want to push boundaries in multimodal AI.

digest_items.title: denoland/celld
digest_items.description: self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects
digest_items.readme:
# celld

Self-hosted, distributed **Durable Objects**.

celld is an open-source daemon that runs Cloudflare Workers and Durable
Objects on your own machines. Each object is its own SQLite database,
addressed by name and replicated to an
S3-compatible bucket you own; nodes coordinate through that bucket alone, with
no control plane or consensus. Because every object is its own small database,
applications shard by construction — the contention and blast-radius failures
of one shared database are designed out, not managed. Idle cells hibernate to
nearly nothing. Learn more at [celld.dev](https://celld.dev) or read the
[documentation](https://celld.dev/docs).

## How it works

Every `celld` node embeds V8 and executes Wrangler bundles. The fleet shares an
S3-compatible bucket containing deployments, cell state, and small ownership
records. Object-storage compare-and-swap ensures that exactly one node owns a
cell at a time, without a membership protocol, failure detector, or consensus
service.

celld continuously replicates each cell's SQLite database to the bucket.
When a cell moves or wakes up, its new owner restores that database and resumes
execution. The bucket is the durable source of truth; nodes are replaceable.

## Install

The installer downloads the `celld` binary (provenance is verifiable with
`gh attestation verify`):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://celld.dev/install.sh | sh
```

Put `~/.local/bin` on your `PATH` if the installer asks you to.

Worker projects deployed with `celld deploy` need
[esbuild](https://esbuild.github.io) on `PATH`; asset-only projects do not.

The installer keeps verified releases under `~/.local/lib/celld/releases` and
atomically switches one `current` pointer. To remove celld, use the guarded
uninstaller:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://celld.dev/uninstall.sh | sh
```

## Container

The release image contains the `celld` binary and is published for Linux
x86-64 and ARM64:

```sh
docker run --rm ghcr.io/denoland/celld --version
```

# Guava: Google Core Libraries for Java

[![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/google/guava)](https://github.com/google/guava/releases/latest)
[![CI](https://github.com/google/guava/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/google/guava/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![OpenSSF Best Practices](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/7197/badge)](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/7197)



Guava is a set of core Java libraries from Google that includes new collection
types (such as multimap and multiset), immutable collections, a graph library,
and utilities for concurrency, I/O, hashing, primitives, strings, and more! It
is widely used on most Java projects within Google, and widely used by many
other companies as well.



Guava comes in two flavors:

*   The JRE flavor requires JDK 1.8 or higher.
*   If you need support for Android, use
    [the Android flavor](https://github.com/google/guava/wiki/Android). You can
    find the Android Guava source in the [`android` directory].

[`android` directory]: https://github.com/google/guava/tree/master/android

## Adding Guava to your build

Guava's Maven group ID is `com.google.guava`, and its artifact ID is `guava`.
Guava provides two different "flavors": one for use on a (Java 8+) JRE and one
for use on Android or by any library that wants to be compatible with Android.
These flavors are specified in the Maven version field as either `33.6.0-jre` or
`33.6.0-android`. For more about depending on Guava, see
[using Guava in your build].

To add a dependency on Guava using Maven, use the following:

```xml
<dependency>

  <artifactId>guava</artifactId>
  <version>33.6.0-jre</version>
  <!-- or, for Android: -->
  <version>33.6.0-android</version>
</dependency>
```
